title: Bounded rectangular TABLECONTENT repeated FIELD references

scope.operation: Write direct references to one simple FIELD from multiple cells in a rectangular TABLECONTENT grid.
scope.profile: Generated AC1027 2x2 grid with two type-2 references to one adapter-authored simple FIELD. One cell contains only the FIELD; another contains a string followed by the same FIELD. ASCII and binary DXF.
scope.source_basis: The decoder retains type-2 per-content FIELD handles in rectangular grids. The existing selected 1x1 writer and adapter profile supported only one reference; the multi-cell writer rejected all type-2 contents and the adapter profile required referenceCount==1. This receipt qualifies the selected generated output profile, not producer-authored source completeness or FIELD evaluation.
limits: One adapter-authored simple FIELD object with the existing qualified field-state profile
Two references to that same FIELD, in separate cells
One reference-only cell and one string-then-reference cell
No linked-data content, block content, attributes, FIELDLIST, child graph, or multiple FIELD objects
scope.claim_boundary: Selected DXF serializer and typed readback evidence only; no FIELD expression evaluation, native table rendering, DWG output, or general FIELD graph claim.

implementation: Extend the rectangular TABLECONTENT writer to validate type-2 content values and require each target to be uniquely present in the emitted FIELD identity map.
Allow the existing adapter-authored simple FIELD profile to serve multiple bounded direct references while retaining its one-FIELD and per-cell composition restrictions.
Use the existing content writer to emit each remapped group-340 reference in cell/content order.

physical_wire: The simple FIELD record precedes its TABLECONTENT consumer and has the expected evaluator, expression, cached string value, empty dependency counts and terminators.
The 2x2 TABLECONTENT record emits exactly two type-2 content spans targeting remapped FIELD handle 1740; the second cell preserves its preceding string content.
evidence.typed_readback: Fresh imports resolve both type-2 content handles to FIELD 1740, preserve the 2x2 grid, the string prefix and the other scalar cells.
evidence.failure_control: Changing one grid reference to an absent FIELD is refused; the destination sentinel, table collection and remaining reference are preserved, while the caller's explicit bad handle remains unchanged.
evidence.retry_control: Restoring the valid source handle and FIELD state permits a successful export through the same adapter; output and fresh typed readback verify both references.

remaining: The parent P5 rendering/TABLE phase remains open.

More than two references, multiple FIELD objects, multiple references within one cell, other scalar combinations, FIELDLIST/child graphs, evaluation semantics, native rendering and DWG output are not claimed.
